description: 장악력(master_supermacy)을 대상 인물별로 계산(개인실·소·조수·노예 공통 처리의 대상 섞임 버그 수정)하고, 구타 경험과 악명 단계(크루얼 -10/-20/-30/-40 → +1~+4) 중 큰 값을 반영

add_locations.name: jo9_supermacy
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START SUPERMACY_PER_TARGET_20261112 | 장악력을 대상 인물별로 계산한다. args[0] = slave, assistant, room1~room4, cow, farmhand 등 인물 배열 이름
! 구타 경험과 악명 단계(jo9_cruel_mercy: -10 무자비 +1, -20 잔인 +2, -30 흉폭 +3, -40 악행 +4) 중 큰 값을 더한다
jo9_sm_value = 0
dynamic $replace("
	jo9_sm_value = (master_cha + master_domination + master_style + master_str + max(dynslave['beaten_ever'], iif(jo9_cruel_mercy <= -40, 4, iif(jo9_cruel_mercy <= -30, 3, iif(jo9_cruel_mercy <= -20, 2, iif(jo9_cruel_mercy <= -10, 1, 0))))) + magna_magnifika + item_supermacy_bonus) - (dynslave['temper'] + dynslave['ego'] + dynslave['pride'] + dynslave['stamina'] + (dynslave['intellect'] - 3))
	if $master_cloth = 'regal_suit': jo9_sm_value += 1
	if $master_cloth = 'comfy_robes': jo9_sm_value -= 1
	if $master_back_wpn = 'посох_огня': jo9_sm_value += 2

	! lolis are easier to dominate.  Uncle Tom is particularly good at it, and it’s easier for Johny to pick on someone smaller than him
	if dynslave['age'] = CONST_INT['loli_age']:
		jo9_sm_value += 2
		if hero_select = 5:  jo9_sm_value += 3  &! Teacher
		if hero_select = 9:  jo9_sm_value += 8  &! Old Man
		if hero_select = 10: jo9_sm_value += 1  &! Kid
	end
	if dynslave['age'] = CONST_INT['milf_age']:
		if hero_select = 8:  jo9_sm_value += 2  &! Butler
		if hero_select = 9:  jo9_sm_value -= 1  &! Old Man
	end
	if dynslave['age'] = CONST_INT['young_age']:
		if hero_select = 5:  jo9_sm_value += 2  &! Teacher
	end
", 'dyn'+'slave', $args[0])
result = jo9_sm_value
! JO9 MOD END SUPERMACY_PER_TARGET_20261112

	if $master_cloth = 'regal_suit': master_supermacy += 1

edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START SUPERMACY_PER_TARGET_20261112_CALC | 대상별 함수로 계산(메인 노예, 없으면 조수)
master_supermacy = func('jo9_supermacy', iif(slave_state > CONST_INT['no_slave'], 'slave', 'assistant'))
! JO9 MOD END SUPERMACY_PER_TARGET_20261112_CALC

edits.old: if master_supermacy < 0: dynslave_rate['instinct'] -= max(0, dynslave['ego'] - (2 + dynslave['fear']))
edits.new: if func('jo9_supermacy', 'dynslave') < 0: dynslave_rate['instinct'] -= max(0, dynslave['ego'] - (2 + dynslave['fear']))

edits.old: daily_bonus[$atr] = max(0, min(6 - dynslave['ego'], max(2, master_supermacy/2), daily_bonus[$atr]))
edits.new: daily_bonus[$atr] = max(0, min(6 - dynslave['ego'], max(2, func('jo9_supermacy', 'dynslave')/2), daily_bonus[$atr]))
